name: Claude for CA — Core
description: Offline memory bank (SQLite), financial integrity guardrails with HITL hooks, append-only audit trail, and compliance calendar monitors. Required by all other claude-for-ca plugins.
author: EurthTech

userConfig.label: CA Firm Name
userConfig.description: Full registered name of the CA firm (e.g. Gorantla Associates)

userConfig.label: Principal CA Name
userConfig.description: Name of the partner or proprietor (e.g. CA Butchi Babu)

userConfig.label: Firm GSTIN
userConfig.description: GSTIN of the CA firm itself (15-character alphanumeric)

userConfig.label: Primary Jurisdiction
userConfig.description: State or city where the firm primarily operates (e.g. Andhra Pradesh)

userConfig.label: Tally ODBC DSN Name
userConfig.description: Windows ODBC data source name for Tally ERP (e.g. TallyODBC64_9000). Leave blank if not using Tally.

userConfig.label: Fiscal Year Start Month
userConfig.description: Month when the Indian fiscal year starts (always April = 4)

userConfig.label: HITL Amount Threshold (₹)
userConfig.description: Tally write operations above this amount (in rupees) trigger enhanced HITL review. Default: 100000 (₹1 lakh).
